Tess H.: heads-up: onboarding mag-14b-int4-compact on staging, ran long-kv-sanity (64k prefill) and hit a tiny token drift right after a compaction event.
Marco D.: snippet?
Tess H.: difflog:
[2026-03-20T22:11:05Z] PREFILL done tokens=65536
[2026-03-20T22:11:05Z] KV-COMPACT start shards=3->2
[2026-03-20T22:11:05Z] KV-COMPACT end duration=5ms
[2026-03-20T22:11:05Z] GENERATE idx=65537 expected="ed" got="d"
Ivy S.: only shows up for compact int4? tried int4-hybrid/int8/fp16?
Tess H.: correct — hybrid/int8/fp16 clean. unpack-reference matches fp16, so bug in compact packer or remap.
Marco D.: try forcing deterministic padding and rerun. also add an assert comparing per-chunk rot_scale before/after compaction.
Tess H.: did that: deterministic padding removed noise but rot_scale array mismatch flagged on boundary case where remaining_tokens % chunk_size == 0.
Marco D.: sounds like remap table off-by-one on exact multiples. quick fix: clamp remap_offset when remainder==0.
Tess H.: patch pushed (tess/compact-remap-clamp), kicked fuzz + quant matrix (16k/64k/131k). build-bot: queued job tess/compact-remap-clamp long-kv-fuzz (id: 2026-03-21-7721).
Ivy S.: add unit that constructs exact-multiple boundary and asserts token-equality vs fp16.
Tess H.: added unit and small csv writer for token_diffs + lat p50/p95. initial fuzz shows diffs=0. will open PR once CI finishes.
build-bot: job tess/compact-remap-clamp long-kv-fuzz passed (id: 2026-03-21-7721).
Marco D.: nice. once merged schedule tiny canary with verbose diff sampling for 15m.
Tess H.: will do, thanks all :thumbsup:
